Recipe: Arancini al ragu.

Recipe: Baba ghanoush.
Only recipe foods: Aubergine; Tahini; Lemon juice; Garlic; Water; Salt; Olive oil; Pomegranate seed.

Stir the Tahini and the Garlic paste into the Lemon juice. The mixture will stiffen. Beat in the cold Water a spoonful at a time until the sauce is pale, smooth and loose. Recipe: Bamieh bi zeit.

Move them to a plate. Trim the stem caps of the Okra in a shallow cone, so that the pods stay whole and do not seep. Brown the pods in a hot pan with more of the Olive oil, turning them, until they are lightly coloured on all sides. Dice the Tomato. Return the Onion to the pan, add the Tomato and the Water, and bring it to a gentle simmer. Cook until the Okra is tender, shaking the pan now and then instead of stirring, so that the pods do not break. Crush the Garlic with a little Salt to a rough paste. Strain it once more for a smooth soup. Bring the soup back to a simmer, stir in the Cream and let it thicken a little. Taste it and Salt it. Ladle the bisque into warm bowls and set the pieces of Lobster meat in the middle.

Skim the fat from the liquid, take out the Bouquet garni, and boil the sauce down, if it is thin, until it coats a spoon. Taste and season. Put the beef back with the Onion and the Mushroom and warm it gently. It is better still the next day.

Add the Butter in cubes and most of the cheese, and beat hard, shaking the pan, until the risotto turns glossy and creamy. Cover for a short rest. Taste, and adjust the Salt. Recipe: Tangia marrakchia.

Recipe: Tarte Tatin.
Only recipe foods: Apple; Sugar; Butter; Water; Puff pastry; Flour.
How it is cooked and served: Peel the Apple. Cut the Apple in half and scoop out the cores. Melt the Sugar with the Water in the ovenproof pan over a medium heat, without stirring, until it turns a deep amber. Take it off the heat and stir in the Butter. Roll the pastry out on a floured surface into a round a little wider than the pan, and chill it while the Apple cook. Pack the Apple halves tightly into the caramel, rounded side down, and cook on the stove until the caramel is thick and the Apple have begun to soften. Lay the pastry over the Apple and tuck the edge down inside the pan. Prick it in a few places and bake until puffed and deep gold. Rest briefly, then lay a plate over the pan and turn it over with care. Lift away the pan and put back any Apple that has stuck to it. Serve warm.

Recipe: Tartiflette.
Only recipe foods: Potato; Reblochon; Bacon (lardons); Onion (peeled, sliced); White wine; Crème fraîche; Salt; Black pepper.

Put the lardons in a cold frying pan over medium heat, let the fat run and brown them. Lift them out. Soften the Onion in the bacon fat over low heat. Recipe: Tiramisu.
Only recipe foods: Egg yolk; Sugar; Marsala; Mascarpone; Coffee; Savoiardi; Cocoa powder.

Stir the cream.mascarpone with a spatula until smooth, without beating it hard. Stir in a spoonful of the cooled foam to loosen it, then fold in the rest in small lots until the cream is smooth. Pour the cooled Coffee into a shallow dish. Pass each biscuit through it in one quick motion, turning it once, and lay it straight into the dish so that it stays firm at the centre. Lay a layer of dipped biscuits in the dish and spread half the cream over them. Make a second layer of biscuits and cover it with the rest of the cream. Chill, covered, until the dessert is firm enough to cut cleanly, ideally overnight, and sift the cocoa over the top just before serving.

Recipe: Grilled sea bream with ladolemono.

Recipe: Vichyssoise.
Only recipe foods: Leek (sliced); Potato (peeled, diced); Butter; White chicken stock; Cream; Chives (chopped); Salt.

Blend the soup in short bursts, in batches, only until it is smooth, and pass it through a fine sieve. Long blending turns Potato to glue. Stir in the Cream. Cool the soup quickly in a bowl set in iced water, then chill it until really cold. Taste it cold and add the rest of the Salt: cold dulls seasoning. Thin it with the cold White chicken stock you kept back if it has set too thick. Ladle into chilled bowls [chives: and scatter with the Chives].

Recipe: Warak enab.
Only recipe foods: Vine leaf; Rice; Tomato; Onion; Parsley; Mint; Allspice; Salt; Olive oil; Lemon juice; Water.

Dice about half the Tomato small for the filling and slice the rest for lining the pot. Mix the drained Rice, the diced Tomato and the Onion with the Parsley, the Mint, the Allspice, half the Salt, half the Olive oil and a little of the Lemon juice. Taste the filling. Trim the stems. Lay a leaf shiny side down, set a little of the filling near the stem end, fold in the sides and roll it up firmly but not tight, so that the Rice has room to swell. Line a wide pot with the sliced Tomato, pack the rolls on top seam down, and pour over the rest of the Olive oil, the rest of the Lemon juice and the Water, with the rest of the Salt. Set a plate on the rolls, cover the pot and simmer on a low heat until the leaves and the Rice is tender. Leave the rolls to cool in the pot. Lift the rolls onto a dish in tight rows and serve them cold or at room temperature, with lemon on the side.

Recipe: Zenzai.
